title: Tea & Magic Hand bubble tea shops (south)
description: Bubble tea chains help separate north and south Taiwan. 'Tea & Magic Hand' (茶の魔手), whose logo is a diagonal lightning-like stroke, is found in the south-west: from Taichung down the western plains to Kaohsiung and Pingtung, and on Penghu. CoCo (blue-and-white drop logo) dominates in the north.

title: CoCo bubble tea shops (north)
description: Bubble tea chains help separate north and south Taiwan. CoCo (都可), with a small blue-and-white drop logo, is concentrated in the north: Taipei, New Taipei, Keelung, Taoyuan, Hsinchu and Miaoli. 'Tea & Magic Hand' (diagonal lightning logo) dominates in the south-west.
